senses.gloss: to do, labor; to make; to act.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 1:7">Targ. Gen. I, 7</cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 31:26">Ib. XXXI, 26</cite>; a. v. fr.—

<cite ref="Berakhot 60b:3-12">Ber. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>לעולם</he> … <he>כל דעביד רחמנא לטב</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>לטב עביד</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 3) man should train himself always to say, Whatever the Merciful One does, is for good; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 893:3">Yalk. Job 893</cite> <he>כל … לטב עביד</he>.
<cite ref="Temurah 4b:32">Tem. 4ᵇ</cite> <he>אי עביד מהני</he>, v. <cite ref="E00676"><he>הֲנִי</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Yevamot 37a:2">Yeb. 37ᵃ</cite> <he>מי עָבוּד רבנן תקנתא וכ׳</he> (not <he>עביד</he>) have the Rabbis adopted special measures for priests &c.? <cite ref="Yevamot 37a:3">Ib.</cite> <he>עַבְדִּינָן כרבנן</he> we act (decide) in accordance with the opinion of the Rabbis.
<cite ref="Ketubot 60b:10">Keth. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>לא עַבְדֵי נשי דחנקן וכ׳</he> women will not do such a thing as strangling their children.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 50a:8">Kidd. 50ᵃ</cite> <he>לא ע׳ אינש דמשוי וכ׳</he> a man will not declare himself a wrongdoer; a. v. fr.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 5:8">Lev. R. s. 5</cite>, end <he>מה את עָבֵיד</he> how art thou?; <he>ומה ארעא עֲבִידָא</he> and how does the field fare?; <he>מה תורין עַבְדִין</he> how are the oxen? <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 5:8">Ib.</cite> <he>ע׳ לב טב</he> he assumes cheerfulness.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 13">Gen. R. s. 13</cite> <he>כל שיחתן … עַבְדַּת ארעא</he> all the talk of people turns on the land (material prosperity): ‘the land is doing well’ (crops promise to be good); ‘the land is not doing well’; a. fr.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 8:5:5">Y. Shebi. VIII, 38ᵇ</cite> top <he>עביד טמיר במערתא וכ׳</he> he remained hidden in a cave &c.; ib. IX, 38ᵈ.
Y. Shek. V, 48ᵈ top עַבְדַת טמירא וכ׳ she (the ass) remained hidden with them &c.; Gen. R. s. 60 עבדת גבון; a. fr.—Part. pass. עָבִיד; f. עֲבִידָא made, liable to, likely, used to.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 3:7:13">Y. Peah III, 17ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>היך ע׳</he> how did it happen (i.e. in what case would it make a practical difference for the slave)? <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 22b:16">R. Hash. 22ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>מילתא דע׳ לאיגלויי</he>, v. <cite ref="C00927"><he>גְּלֵי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shevuot 46a:15">Shebu. 46ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="C00569"><he>גְּזַם</he></cite>; a. fr.

<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 32:10">Targ. O. Ex. XXXII, 10</cite> <cite ref="P00014"><he>אַעַבֵּיד</he></cite> ed. Berl. (oth. <cite ref="P00014"><he>אַעֲבֵיד</he></cite>; Y. <he>אֶעְבַּד</he>). Ib. XXX, 37; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 28:6">Lev. R. s. 28</cite>, end, v. infra.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 13">Gen. R. s. 13</cite> <he>כל תפלתן … מרי תַעֲבִיד ארעא יכ׳</he> all the prayers of men turn on the earth (mundane affairs): Lord, make the land (crop) thrive, make the land prosper; a. e.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 116b:12">B. Mets. 116ᵇ</cite> <he>טינא דמע׳</he> thoroughly kneaded clay.

senses.gloss: to be done; to be made, become.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 29:26">Targ. Gen. XXIX, 26</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 8:4">Targ. Koh. VIII, 4</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 62:4">Targ. Ps. LXII, 4</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2:16">Lam. R. to II, 2</cite> <he>בעית לאִיעַבְדָּא וכ׳</he> (not <he>לאיבדא</he>, <he>לעיבדא</he>) dost thou want to be made a senator? <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 28:6">Lev. R. s. 28</cite>, end <he>מאן דעַבֵּיד … אתע׳ וכ׳</he> he who made the comes …, is now to become a bather &c.; <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 10:4">Esth. R. to VI, 10</cite> <he>האי גברא מְעַבֵּיד … עביד בלן</he> (corr. acc.); a. fr. [<cite ref="Zevachim 75b:18">Zeb. 75ᵇ</cite> <he>דאיעבד</he>, read: <he>דאיערוב</he>, v. <cite ref="P01252"><he>עֲרַב</he> I</cite>.]—V. <cite ref="D00671"><he>דִּיעֲבַד</he></cite>.
